summary: Frontend-only regression on the UI redesign (folio). All 12 acceptance checks pass on mobile viewport 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Login screen renders ONLY wordmark 'folio' + tagline + single CTA 'Masuk untuk mulai' (no extra paragraphs). Direct URL access to /pesanan and /supplier without token redirects to /login. Dashboard loads with floating pill bar containing exactly 5 tabs [tab-dashboard, tab-pesanan, tab-persediaan, tab-customer, tab-ekspor] + fab-pesanan-baru. tab-supplier is NOT present. Text label is shown ONLY on the active tab. Supplier card (buka-supplier) is on Dashboard, opens /supplier (full page with screen-back), adding a supplier persists after reload and the Dashboard counter updates. FAB opens full-page /pesanan-baru (input-nama, input-wa, input-alamat, input-kota, input-kec, picker-jenis, input-transfer, simpan-pesanan, batal-pesanan, screen-back). Create order from FAB persists after reload. Edit via ubah-pesanan-<id> prefills the form, saves transfer=999.000 and NO duplicate card is created (card count stays constant before/after). lihat-detail-<id> opens Penerima/Pesanan/Pengiriman/Rekapan with working 'Hapus pesanan'. Ekspor tab has unduh-excel + salin-tsv; Customer tab renders; Persediaan tab shows 'Sekarang' (FIFO) column. Dashboard profil-card edit + simpan-profil persist; logout-btn returns to login. Content is not occluded by the floating nav (reset-demo at y=1268 vs nav at y=780-824). Console has no 'key prop spread' or font errors; only non-blocking warnings 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (RN Web) and 'useNativeDriver is not supported' (web preview). Transient 'Unexpected text node: .' warnings seen once during an earlier mid-flow render (3 occurrences) but did not reproduce on the clean full run — flagged as minor.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses prop `pointerEvents="box-none"` which triggers React Native Web deprecation warning. Should migrate to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/tab-bar.tsx:40 and :57

action_items: Low-priority: replace `pointerEvents="box-none"` with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` in /app/frontend/src/components/tab-bar.tsx to clear RN Web deprecation warning.

Low-priority: investigate transient 'Unexpected text node: .' warning (3 occurrences during persediaan flow in one run, did not reproduce). Likely a conditional render that returns a bare string/'.' inside a <View>. Candidates: Rekapan / profil-card / ui.tsx Field rendering empty strings between <View> children.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx: Stack is declared with only one explicit <Stack.Screen> entry ('pesanan-baru' as modal). All other routes are auto-registered by expo-router. OK.

pesanan-baru.tsx: Edit mode uses `stokState = state without current pesanan` to recompute sisa stok correctly — good. simpan() replaces by id (no duplicate) and `router.back()` after save — matches tested behavior.
tab-bar.tsx: FAB uses router.push('/pesanan-baru'); _layout declares the route as modal presentation — tested working, back/batal both close via router.back().

login.tsx: Content layout uses `justifyContent: 'space-between'` so wordmark+tagline sit at top and CTA at bottom. Only one <Pressable> testID='login-google' — matches requirement of exactly one CTA with no extra copy.
seed_data_creation: Reused QA session from iteration_1 (user_qa0000000001, token qa-token-123). No new seed required; token verified working via /api/auth/me.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign verified end-to-end on 390x844: login (folio wordmark + tagline + 'Masuk untuk mulai'), redirect gate, floating pill tab bar (5 tabs active-label-only), center FAB → modal /pesanan-baru, Supplier moved to Dashboard shortcut (buka-supplier) + full-page /supplier, Pesanan create/edit (no duplicate on edit), detail/hapus, Ekspor/Customer/Persediaan, profil edit/logout. New testIDs in use: tab-{dashboard|pesanan|persediaan|customer|ekspor}, fab-pesanan-baru, screen-back, batal-pesanan, buka-supplier. Note: Picker.openness in /pesanan-baru briefly keeps overlays mounted; a safer selector pattern is to click an option by data-testid and wait >=400ms before next action.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Minor non-blocking deprecation warnings only.
